content:
Goal
* The variable name "Total Cost" is declared before the formulas but isn't used afterwards. "Profit" and "Loss" are referenced in the output requirements but aren't defined. It's inconsistent that the formulas use variable names in some places but not in others. Please rewrite and reformat the relevant sections as follows:

-----
<<Formulas:>>
[[Total Cost]] = Fixed Cost ([[fc]]) + Variable Cost ([[vc]])
[[Net Result]] = [[revenue]] - [[Total Cost]]
[[Profit Margin percentage]] = ([[Net Result]] / [[revenue]]) × {{100}}

Note: If [[revenue]] is {{0}}, [[Profit Margin percentage]] is automatically {{-100%}}.

<<Output Requirements:>>
Your program must output a single line summarising the financial status:

If [[Net Result]] is {{0}}: {{BREAK-EVEN}}
Otherwise: [[status]] {{| Net:}} [[Net Result]] {{| Margin:}} [[Profit Margin percentage]]{{%}}
where [[status]] is either:
{{PROFITABLE}} if [[Net Result]] is greater than {{0}}, or
{{LOSS}} if [[Net Result]] is less than {{0}}.
-----

Constraints
* Please replace all the existing constraints with the following to align more closely with the test cases:

0 ≤ [[fc]], [[vc]], [[revenue]] ≤ 1,000,000

Stub generator
* Line 3: Please change "float" to "int" to match the Input section.

Cases
* Validator 1: Please adjust the case so that the profit margin percentage is an integer and doesn't require rounding.

* Please add Test/Validator 5 where the profit margin percentage is positive and rounds up.

* Please add Test/Validator 6 where the profit margin percentage is positive and rounds down.

* Please add Test/Validator 7 where the profit margin percentage is negative and rounds up.

* Please add Test/Validator 8 where the profit margin percentage is negative and rounds down.

Thanks.
